title: Module 2: authority, tools and runtime truth

checks.title: B1 read-side tools: numbered reads and their decoder (R-24), limits and refusals, containment on the read side (R-30)
B1 tool-slot policy: six essentials within eight slots, optional order, lower caps, excluded essentials refuse
B2 per-invocation shell approval through the dispatch boundary: repository content grants nothing, trust changes nothing, every invocation asks with its exact bytes, legacy grants never run
B3 tool capability contract at the service layer: the wire carries only contracted tools by default and with the network opt-in (R-05); a stored note needs a confirmation that shows its origin (R-59)
B3 upstream's Agent Host is excluded: the switch is off and no agent-host session type can start a chat (the packaged smoke and the end-to-end suite check that it never starts)
Every defect fixed in this module has a resurrection mutant that its script and the seeded campaign detect
